# ghost/kfz-d

KFZ-D (F-Droid): look up the district, federal state and type behind a German licence plate code such as M or HH. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/kfz-d
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/kfz-d open_lookup --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/kfz-d lookup --device <serial> --param code=<code>
ghost skill run ghost/kfz-d lookup_many --device <serial> --param codes=<codes>
ghost skill run ghost/kfz-d get_result --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_lookup`: Open the German licence plate lookup
- `lookup`: Which city has the German licence plate code M?
- `lookup_many`: Look up the German plate codes M, HH and B
- `get_result`: What does the plate lookup show now?
